rows.value: Debug text-area blur with nested template
For each test, type a new value, then click the button straight from the text area (don't click elsewhere first).
✅ Emit carried the latest text area value
❌ Emit value differs from the text area value

rows.name: debug_text_area_nested_btn
rows.action_list: completed | set_local: local_set_from_child: @local.text_area_1; completed | set_local: emit_count: @local.emit_count + 1

rows.value: In this case, the value is actually passed in to the nested template, therefore the nested template does need to rebuild on changes to the input value, and so the first click after typing in the text box is still "lost". That is currently the expected behaviour in this case: the first click to deselect the text input component does not trigger the button's actions, subsequent clicks do.
